en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a grand vaulted hall in a historic building. The room has high, ribbed Gothic ceilings and pointed arch doorways. Large wall murals depict dramatic battle and historical scenes with soldiers, horses, and crowds. The lower walls are paneled in dark wood. There is an ornate wooden cabinet on the left, a circular table with carved chairs on the right, and a wall shelf above a doorway holding a large globe and books. The photograph has a narrow black border, and on the far left edge there are faint handwritten numbers or notes.
